Learning by building

Selected Projects

Python · Data · Logic

Student Performance Analysis

Python · pandas · Matplotlib · Seaborn

A data-analysis project using a CSV dataset with students’ marks and attendance. The program calculates average marks in Maths, Physics, and Programming, identifies the highest and lowest programming marks, and finds the top performer based on average marks.

Visual outputs: a bar chart of programming marks and a scatter plot comparing attendance with average marks.

What I practised: reading structured data, calculating summary statistics, identifying patterns, and presenting results visually.

Python project

Morse Code Translator

Python · String handling · Logic

A simple Python program that converts English text into Morse Code and decodes Morse Code back into English. It helped me practise character mapping, string handling, and step-by-step problem-solving.

Key feature: two-way conversion between English and Morse Code.

Writing & reflection

Academic Writing Assessment

How Data Can Support Better Decisions

Data becomes useful when it helps people ask clearer questions and make better-informed decisions. In a student performance analysis project, for example, marks and attendance can be organised into a table, summarised with simple calculations, and explored through charts. These steps make it easier to notice patterns that might be difficult to see in raw numbers alone.

However, data should be interpreted carefully. An average can summarise a group, but it does not explain every student’s experience. A relationship between attendance and marks does not automatically prove that one causes the other. The quality of a conclusion depends on the quality of the data, the method used, and the context surrounding the results.

My main learning is that programming and data visualisation are not only about producing outputs. They are also about communicating evidence clearly, recognising limitations, and being honest about what the results can and cannot show. This approach can help turn technical work into practical insight.

Reflection: Writing this assessment helped me connect a programming project with clear explanation, careful reasoning, and responsible interpretation of results.
